entries.english_reference: My school told me it was too\ndangerous to come here.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Na escola, me disseram que era\nperigoso demais vir aqui.

entries.english_reference: That's what I get for not\nlistening.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: É nisso que dá não\nouvir os outros.

entries.english_reference: Be careful while exploring\nthe volcano.<0xFB>There's plenty of exposed magma\neverywhere.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Cuidado ao explorar\no vulcão.<0xFB>Há muito magma exposto\npor toda parte.

entries.english_reference: I heard there was a rare bird-type\nPokémon around here.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Ouvi falar de um Pokémon raro\ndo tipo Pássaro por aqui.

entries.english_reference: The bird is said to have wings\nof fire!
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Dizem que esse pássaro tem asas\nde fogo!

entries.english_reference: There's no such thing as a\nbird-type Pokémon, is there?<0xFB>No wonder I can't find the\nrare Pokémon!
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Não existe Pokémon do tipo\nPássaro, existe?<0xFB>Por isso não acho esse\nPokémon raro!

entries.english_reference: When one is this far into the\nvolcano, one should ask themself:<0xFA>should I continue on, or go home?
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Tão fundo no vulcão, é bom\nperguntar a si mesmo:<0xFA>continuar ou voltar para casa?

entries.english_reference: One does not simply decide in\nan instant.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Não dá para decidir isso\nnum instante.

entries.english_reference: Which way will you choose to go?
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Qual caminho você vai escolher?

entries.english_reference: It's about to get lit!
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: O negócio vai esquentar!

entries.english_reference: This place is so hot.<0xFB>It's too easy to start a fire!
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Aqui é tão quente.<0xFB>É fácil demais causar um incêndio!

entries.english_reference: Have a look at my fire-resistant\nPokémon!
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Veja meus Pokémon resistentes\nao fogo!

entries.english_reference: They weren't as resistant as\nI thought.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Não eram tão resistentes\nquanto eu pensava.

entries.english_reference: I came here to train my Pokémon\nthat have a natural weakness to<0xFA>Fire-types.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Vim treinar meus Pokémon\nque têm fraqueza natural<0xFA>ao tipo Fogo.

entries.english_reference: Do you feel that the bridges\nare sturdy?<0xFB>Are you afraid they could collapse\nunder you at any moment?
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Você acha que estas pontes\nsão firmes?<0xFB>Tem medo de que desabem\nsob seus pés a qualquer hora?

entries.english_reference: Don't worry!\nThe bridges won't collapse.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Não se preocupe!\nAs pontes não vão cair.

entries.english_reference: All these bridges were designed\nto withstand the immense heat.<0xFB>That's why they're red, as opposed\nto the normal light blue.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Todas estas pontes foram feitas\npara resistir ao calor extremo.<0xFB>Por isso são vermelhas,\nem vez do azul-claro normal.

entries.english_reference: I have secluded myself in this cave\nto train my mind and body.<0xFB>Bring your worst!
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Eu me isolei nesta caverna\npara treinar corpo e mente.<0xFB>Pode vir com tudo!

entries.english_reference: I must not have trained enough.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Acho que não treinei o bastante.

entries.english_reference: I will continue to train.<0xFB>Someday, I will become the\nultimate warrior.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Vou continuar treinando.<0xFB>Um dia, vou me tornar\no guerreiro supremo.

entries.english_reference: I have come to this volcano to\npaint a piece filled with my<0xFA>burning passion.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Vim a este vulcão para pintar\numa obra cheia da minha<0xFA>paixão ardente.

entries.english_reference: Your moves flowed like lava.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Seus movimentos fluíam como lava.

entries.english_reference: The lava here is the inspiration\nfor all my greatest works.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: A lava daqui inspira\ntodas as minhas grandes obras.

entries.english_reference: This volcano houses many secrets!
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Este vulcão abriga muitos segredos!

entries.english_reference: You are a mysterious young fellow.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Você é uma pessoa misteriosa.

entries.english_reference: I will unravel the secrets of\nCinder Volcano!
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Vou desvendar os segredos de\nCinder Volcano!

entries.english_reference: Into the fiery pit we go!
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Vamos entrar na fornalha!

entries.english_reference: Just kidding, I'm not going\nanywhere.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Brincadeira, não vou\na lugar nenhum.

entries.english_reference: I'm going to stay rooted to this\nspot for all of eternity.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Vou ficar plantado neste\nlugar por toda a eternidade.

entries.english_reference: Did you know?<0xFB>The Slugma in this volcano burn\nhotter than the sun!
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Você sabia?<0xFB>Os Slugma deste vulcão queimam\nmais quente que o sol!

entries.english_reference: Ahhhhh! I'm melting!
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Ahhhhh! Estou derretendo!

entries.english_reference: Who in their right mind would\nbelieve that Slugma and Magcargo<0xFA>burn hotter than the sun?<0xFB>We'd all roast alive if they did!
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Quem em sã consciência acha\nque Slugma e Magcargo queimam<0xFA>mais quente que o sol?<0xFB>Se fosse assim, estaríamos assados!

entries.english_reference: Staring out into the vast ocean of\nlava just melts my heart.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Olhar este vasto oceano de\nlava derrete meu coração.

entries.english_reference: You have melted my heart.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Você derreteu meu coração.

entries.english_reference: Sometimes I like to stare at Gems\nlike these to become one with the<0xFA>magma.<0xFB>You are deserving of this Gem.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Às vezes, olho Gems como estas\npara me tornar um só com o<0xFA>magma.<0xFB>Você merece esta Gem.

entries.english_reference: The magma is beautiful, isn't it?<0xFB>Sometimes I like to let my\n<0xFC>ÀÉFire<0xFC>ÀÇ-type Pokémon take me for a<0xFA>ride on it.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: O magma é lindo, não é?<0xFB>Às vezes, meus Pokémon do tipo\n<0xFC><0x01><0x06>Fogo<0xFC><0x01><0x04> me levam para dar uma<0xFA>volta sobre ele.

The fact that you are here means
you have acquired at least four<0xFA>Gym Badges.<0xFB>But Badges alone are not enough to
prove your worth to me.<0xFB>I will challenge you to a battle
if, and only if you defeat all<0xFA>other Trainers in Cinder Volcano.

Se você está aqui, é porque
conseguiu ao menos quatro<0xFA>Insígnias de Ginásio.<0xFB>Mas só Insígnias não bastam

entries.english_reference: The fact that you're here means\nyou have acquired at least four<0xFA>Gym Badges.<0xFB>Now, show me the strength of a\nTrainer with four Badges!
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Se você está aqui, é porque\nconseguiu ao menos quatro<0xFA>Insígnias de Ginásio.<0xFB>Mostre a força de um Treinador\ncom quatro Insígnias!

entries.english_reference: I wouldn't expect any less from\nsomeone of your caliber.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Eu não esperava menos de\nalguém do seu nível.

entries.english_reference: Take this.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Pegue isto.

entries.english_reference: That is a gift for defeating me.<0xFB>Give it to a <0xFC>ÀÉCamerupt<0xFC>ÀË and it will\nbe able to Mega Evolve in battle,<0xFA>assuming you have a Keystone.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: É um presente por me vencer.<0xFB>Dê isto a <0xFC><0x01><0x06>Camerupt<0xFC><0x01><0x08> e ele poderá\nusar Mega Evolution em batalha,<0xFA>se você tiver uma Keystone.

entries.english_reference: Hunter of the Swamp
entries.reason: Titre ou objectif de mission ; noms des ingrédients anglais conservés suivant F-759.
entries.portuguese: Caçador do Pântano

entries.english_reference: Help a scientist learn about the\nPokémon living in Cootes Bog! Use\nthe DexNav to help catch them all.
entries.reason: Titre ou objectif de mission ; noms des ingrédients anglais conservés suivant F-759.
entries.portuguese: Ajude a estudar os Pokémon de\nCootes Bog! Use o DexNav para\najudar a capturar todos eles.

entries.english_reference:
Hi, Trainer.<0xFB>Oh! I see you possess a DexNav.
I have just the task for you.<0xFB>Would you use your DexNav to aid
yourself in the capture of all of<0xFA>the Pokémon that live in this area?<0xFB>I want to know all about the
Pokémon that live in Cootes Bog.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese:
Oi, Treinador.<0xFB>Oh! Você tem um DexNav.
Tenho a tarefa certa para você.<0xFB>Você usaria seu DexNav para
ajudar a capturar todos<0xFA>os Pokémon desta área?<0xFB>Quero saber tudo sobre os
Pokémon que vivem em Cootes Bog.

entries.english_reference: Hi, Trainer.<0xFB>If you acquire a DexNav, would you\ncome back and speak with me?<0xFB>I have a task only capable of\nbeing completed by a Trainer<0xFA>possessing a DexNav.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Oi, Treinador.<0xFB>Se conseguir um DexNav, pode\nvoltar para falar comigo?<0xFB>Tenho uma tarefa que só\npode ser feita por um Treinador<0xFA>que tenha um DexNav.

entries.english_reference: Perfect!<0xFB>Please report back to me when your\nDexNav indicates that all of the<0xFA>Pokémon here have been caught.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Perfeito!<0xFB>Volte quando seu DexNav\nindicar que todos os Pokémon<0xFA>daqui foram capturados.

entries.english_reference: It seems you are not as interested\nin your DexNav as I am, I suppose.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Pelo visto, seu DexNav não\ninteressa tanto a você quanto a mim.

entries.english_reference: Your DexNav shows that you've\ncaught all of the Pokémon that<0xFA>live in the swamp!<0xFB>Perfect!\nThis is my thanks!
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Seu DexNav mostra que capturou\ntodos os Pokémon que vivem<0xFA>no pântano!<0xFB>Perfeito!\nIsto é para agradecer!

entries.english_reference: And let me modify your DexNav, too!
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: E vou modificar seu DexNav também!

entries.english_reference: <0xFC>ÀÁThe DexNav has been upgraded to\nshow possible held items!
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: <0xFC><0x01><0x02>O DexNav agora pode mostrar\npossíveis itens segurados!

entries.english_reference: Your DexNav shows that there are\nstill some Pokémon here you<0xFA>haven't caught, yet.<0xFB>Keep on hunting!
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Seu DexNav mostra que ainda\nhá Pokémon aqui que você<0xFA>não capturou.<0xFB>Continue procurando!

entries.english_reference: Finding all of the Pokémon that can\nbe found in the swamp is amazing!
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Encontrar todos os Pokémon\ndo pântano é incrível!

entries.english_reference: There are two paths to proceed\nthrough the swamp: the bog path<0xFA>and the bridge path.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Há dois caminhos pelo pântano:\na trilha pela lama e o caminho<0xFA>pelas pontes.

entries.english_reference: The bog path is quicker, but it\nalso has more wild Pokémon.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: A trilha pela lama é mais rápida,\nmas tem mais Pokémon selvagens.

entries.english_reference: This is the path through the bog.<0xFB>You can take it to get to\nCrystal Peak.<0xFB>If you want to take the bridge\npath, go back.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Esta é a trilha pela lama.<0xFB>Ela leva você até\nCrystal Peak.<0xFB>Se quiser ir pelas pontes,\nvolte.

entries.english_reference: This swamp is watched over by one\nof Tessy's Pokémon.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Um dos Pokémon de Tessy\ntoma conta deste pântano.

entries.english_reference: It's a good thing I am not the only\none watching over this swamp.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Que bom que não sou o único\na tomar conta deste pântano.

entries.english_reference: We Rangers assist the swamp's\nprotector by any means necessary.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Nós, Rangers, ajudamos o protetor\ndo pântano de todas as formas.

entries.english_reference: This swamp is the perfect place to\nambush unsuspecting Trainers.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Este pântano é perfeito para\nemboscar Treinadores distraídos.

entries.english_reference: Next time, I will wallow in\nswamp mud so nobody will smell<0xFA>me approaching.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Da próxima vez, vou me cobrir\nde lama para ninguém sentir<0xFA>meu cheiro quando eu chegar.

entries.english_reference: This swamp has so many places\nto hide, who knows what might<0xFA>be hidden here?
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Este pântano tem tantos\nesconderijos... Quem sabe o que<0xFA>pode estar escondido aqui?

entries.english_reference: This swamp is really a living being\nwith a powerful spirit.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: Este pântano é um ser vivo\ncom um espírito poderoso.

entries.english_reference: The spirit of the swamp is\nwith you.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
entries.portuguese: O espírito do pântano está\ncom você.

entries.english_reference: We must respect the spirit of the\nswamp, so don't litter.
entries.reason: Dialogue/scénario : pointeurs de scripts vivants, commandes et pages préservées.
